entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This sucks.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I can't believe every place is full...[n]Christmas Eve really is a war zone.
Whoops, our bad.
I'm starving.
I'm fine if I've got you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, for real. We gotta make a[n]reservation next year.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ugh, me too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's okay though! Even if we don't get[n]a fancy dinner, we've still got one last[n]shot!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Where'd that come from? Not that[n]I'm not happy to hear it...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We just gotta pull it together...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...And go get a cake!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So let's go hit the stores!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ugh... Something tells me they're[n]sold out too...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Excuse me, you guys don't have any[n]Christmas cakes left, do you?

entries.speaker: Cheerful Female Employee
entries.en: Actually, we do!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, I figured— Wait, what?

entries.speaker: Cheerful Female Employee
entries.en: One of our orders was canceled last-[n]minute. This is the only cake we have!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What!? Then...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yes! We want it! We'll pay right now!

entries.speaker: Cheerful Female Employee
entries.en: Of course! Just wait one moment[n]while I go prepare your order!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wow... Did that just happen?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This isn't like a hidden camera thing,[n]right?
It's not THAT surprising.
Aren't you happy?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, sorry. I was just so happy I kinda[n]short-circuited.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But we got cake! Yaaay cake![n]Let's head home and dig in!
